decisions.mark: names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive that stops the compiler from knowing a value, and locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` is an empty `asm volatile` barrier when assembly is available. decisions.mark: explains that the asm path is an EMPTY asm volatile statement with the value as an input-output register operand — it emits no instruction and exists solely as an optimisation barrier
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` is an empty `asm volatile` barrier when assembly is available. | WHY: The answer says it is an empty asm volatile barrier. It doesn't say the value is an input-output register operand, and it doesn't say that no instruction is emitted and the statement exists only as an optimisation barrier.
